name: domains
description: Domain portfolio, registrar, marketplace, and DNS management for AI agents. Four surfaces: CLI (domains), MCP (domains-mcp), HTTP API (domains-serve), and a generated SDK (@hasna/domains/sdk). Local mode uses SQLite at ~/.local/share/open-domains/domains.db; cloud mode (HASNA_DOMAINS_STORAGE_MODE=cloud) is PURE REMOTE per Amendment A1 — the serve reads/writes the shared cloud Postgres directly, no cache or sync in the service.

serve.auth: api-key (@hasna/contracts) — header x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer
